model = RotationSequence3D(11*u.deg, 59*u.deg, 311*u.deg, axes_order=['x','y','z'])

# Create test data with NaN values
lon = np.array([0., 0., 31., 97., 173., 227., 311.])
lat = np.array([0., 67., 29., 7., -13., -43., -73.])

s2c = SphericalToCartesian()

lat_with_nan[is_nan] = np.nan
